title: Freud's 1895 dream foreshadowing his oral cancer

tellings.quote: a dream he had in 1895 um famous dream and he spent like 14 pages of his his Landmark book

plain: A famous dream the psychiatrist Sigmund Freud had in 1895 is said to foreshadow the mouth cancer he was found to have decades later. The researcher Eric Wargo makes this case, noting that Freud spent about 14 pages on the dream in his landmark book The Interpretation of Dreams. Wargo raises it as a sign that dreams can glimpse the future.
